articles.summary: Each month, Cyabra's experts share the articles, reports, and investigations shaping the conversation around misinformation, narrative intelligence and deepfakes. This September, from AI chatbots buckling under sustained misinformation pressure to the growing legal fight against deepfake harm, one thing is clear: as generative AI reshapes how false narratives are created and corrected, distinguishing reliable information from AI-amplified falsehoods is more critical than ever.
articles.title: Misinformation Monthly – October

articles.summary: Cyabra’s 2026 U.S. Midterm research found coordinated inauthentic accounts in five of six competitive races, concentrated in the replies on candidates’ own X accounts, where they can pass for real voter sentiment.
articles.title: Inauthentic Accounts Crowd Midterm Candidates’ Replies

articles.summary: The organizations best prepared for coordinated manipulation treat it the way they treat cyber threats: as a standing risk with clear owners, defined processes, and board attention. That approach is spreading, and narrative intelligence is on its way to becoming as expected as cybersecurity. In June, Cyabra was named a Market Shaper in the 2026 Gartner® Emerging Market Quadrant for Narrative Intelligence - Startup Vendors, the first report to define this market.
articles.title: Why Narrative Intelligence Is Becoming as Essential as Cybersecurity
